name: universal-ai-skills
description: Router-first AI skill system for Codex, Claude, Cursor, Hermes, Paperclip, OpenCode, and local AI stacks: search, preflight-route, and load 1,810 skills on demand without duplicating the corpus.

interface.longDescription: Search, preflight-route, and load one relevant skill on demand from a shared 1,810-skill corpus. Skills stay in the repository under skills/ instead of being copied into every AI client or injected into always-loaded context. The legacy `manus` command remains a compatibility alias.
